## Beta — Cleanup and fixes

A maintenance release: no new features, less code, two bug fixes.

### Fixes
- **Calendar and overnight / multi-day slots**: the `calendar` entity missed slots that started on a previous day. A slot Monday 22:00 → Tuesday 06:00 was not "on" at 03:00 on Tuesday, and a Monday → Thursday slot did not appear when only Wednesday was requested. A range ending at an earlier time of day than it started also lost its last day. All fixed (the scheduler, the sensor and the weekly card were not affected).
- **Renaming a planner** from its options now updates the sensor, calendar and device names right away (the integration is reloaded), without restarting Home Assistant.

### Changes
- **`run_rule_now`** now runs through the same path as scheduled rules: fresh context and a `chronotask_action` event with `part: run_now`. As an explicit command it also acts on held entities (the hold stays in place).
- **Minimum Home Assistant version: 2024.7** (declared in HACS). The fallback for older versions has been removed.
- **Diagnostics** now include the integration version and the active holds.

### Under the hood
- The three cards share a small module (`chronotask-common.js`) for tags and translations, loaded with the version in the URL. Each card keeps its own texts.
- Weekly card: removed unused functions, texts and variables; one helper for "HH:MM" times; temporary "saving…" blocks reuse the normal block rendering; the list of actions in the rule dialog is rebuilt only when an entity is picked, not at every keystroke.
- Backend: removed an unused module and constants; start/end scheduling merged into one function; the sensor no longer recalculates twice for each change; the calendar ignores changes of other planners; time parsing shared in one place.
- New tests for the calendar, scheduling, `run_rule_now` and sensor refresh (38 in total, no Home Assistant needed).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/andker87/Home-Assistant-ChronoTask/compare/v1.7.0...v1.7.1-beta1
